The Authentic Name

Scholarly reference for Wurušemu

Scholarly Transliteration

Wurušemu

The original script for this hittite name has not yet been added to PUNYCODEX. The form shown is a scholarly transliteration.

ASCII Constraint

WURUSEMU

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Wurušemu

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
wurušemu.com → xn--wuruemu-tqb.com

The non-ASCII characters in Wurušemu are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Wurušemu. PUNYCODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Tier Classification

Why Wurušemu is classified as Tier-2 Basic

The Ancient form Wurušemu preserves neither stress nor length in this Unicode restoration. This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 Basic name — still a scholarly step above plain ASCII, but without the distinctive phonetic features that define higher tiers.
